settings.title: What are Viper Deck 500 Ground Protection Mats used for in Canada?
settings.text: Viper Deck 500 Ground Protection Mats are designed to protect grass, turf, and sensitive ground from damage. They are commonly used in Canadian construction sites, landscaping projects, outdoor events, and even heavy-duty industrial applications where stable temporary roadways or work pads are needed.

settings.title: How much weight can these rig mats support?
settings.text: Each Viper Deck 500 rig mat can handle up to 80 tons, making them ideal for heavy trucks, trailers, and equipment operating on soft or unstable Canadian terrain such as mud, snow, and sand.

settings.title: Are these ground mats suitable for Canadian winters?
settings.text: Yes. Unlike plywood or fiberglass, Viper Deck Ground Protection Mats don’t crack, rot, or absorb moisture. They perform reliably in harsh Canadian winters and remain safe to use in extreme cold and snow conditions.

settings.title: Can the Viper Deck 500 be used as grass protection mats?
settings.text: Absolutely. These mats are perfect grass protection mats for Canadian stadiums, parks, golf courses, and event venues, preventing rutting and soil compaction while keeping turf safe from damage.

settings.title: How do the Viper Deck mats stay in place?
settings.text: The mats can be connected using secure links that lock them together. This reduces the risk of slippage, even when vehicles drive over them at higher speeds on wet or muddy ground.

settings.title: Why choose ground protection mats instead of plywood in Canada?
settings.text: Plywood warps, rots, and absorbs water, especially in wet or snowy Canadian conditions. Viper Deck Ground Protection Mats are a superior alternative—they’re durable, reusable, and resistant to rot, cracks, and bacteria, ensuring long-term use and lower replacement costs.

settings.title: Where can I buy rig mats for sale in Canada?
settings.text: Viper Deck 500 Ground Protection Mats are available through Canada Mats, with nationwide shipping options. Contact us for a quote and wholesale pricing on rig mats for your project.

settings.title: Are these mats easy to install and remove?
settings.text: Yes. Viper Deck ground mats are lightweight yet strong, allowing for quick installation and dismantling on job sites, saving you time and labor.

settings.title: DESIGNED FOR MAXIMUM TRACTION
settings.text:
The mats feature rugged and smooth patterns on alternating sides for versatile use.

The rugged surface delivers maximum traction for vehicles and equipment, while the smooth side evenly distributes weight to protect grass, turf, and sensitive ground.

settings.title: VIPER DECK 500 CONNECTORS
settings.text: Available in 2 Prong single connectors or 4 Prong double connectors configurations, these connectors are used to hold the Viper Deck mats in place during deployment to ensure a secure fit and stronger traction.
